title: Unit Event — Find A Way Out — Episode4 Surpassing Everyone In Town

meta.Event Outline: Tis the season to be jolly and Vivid BAD SQUAD is all gathered at Weekend Garage. They discuss performing at the live house where RADder debuted, but Akito seems to have some history with said venue...

rows.Line: The night of RAD WEEKEND
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Okay... R-A-D-d-e-r...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Oh, there's a bunch of videos of them online. But they're mostly of their shows. They really don't have that many music videos...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll start by watching the one with the most views...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Even in video form, they're beyond incredible...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (All of their songs have this way of waking you up because they're so electrifying.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (This thought crossed my mind when I went to the Summer Festival with Ena...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (But music really is awesome...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I ended up listening to the same song over and over again. I was hoping to listen to more...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
But I feel kinda tired for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
When did I clench my hands like that?
So hard that my nails left imprints too...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I guess I was listening to it just that intently...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I don't think I ever became this focused when I was still playing soccer...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I thought I was taking it seriously...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (But then I realized that there were other people who were actually devoting their lives to it...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (There was no way that I would've been able to make the same commitment.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Maybe I feel the same way about music. I can't honestly say if I'm prepared to make those kinds of sacrifices...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (But putting on an event like that one has to be the best feeling in the world...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (If I could sing like them...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: You can think about taking it up seriously later on.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I don't know if I'm willing to devote my life to it...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I don't know... But I wanna give it a try.
One week later
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Argh! Why do I sound so bad...?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: What do I need to do to be able to sing like RADder?! How do I produce that jolt?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I need to learn more...
The next day
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I watched RADder videos a bunch of times yesterday after practice, but I still couldn't find an answer...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I have no idea how to get better in a way that lets me sing like them...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (But I might just learn something if I see them live again...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I heard that they perform at the live house from that night... COL.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: It should be right around... Found it!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(Wait, it's so quiet...
And they have hardly any flyers posted.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(Are they not doing any events?
But the front door's open... I think there's people inside.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I'll try going in...)
COL

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: Hm? Who are you...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
Should I not have walked in?

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
We did leave the door open.

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: So, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
So, um...
I was wondering when RADder would be doing their next event...

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: Ah, I see. Were you here to see RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: That's cool. Unfortunately...

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: RADder's probably going on hiatus for a while.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
No...
But they're such amazing singers...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: And they're able to put on mind-blowing events like RAD WEEKEND! Why now...?!

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: You're right. Without RADder, there wouldn't have been a RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: They, along with all the other musicians who participated, put on the best performance ever.

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: Sadly, no one is probably going to put on a better event anytime soon.

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: Also, this place is closing up shop at the end of the week. So, as much as I hate to say this, no events will be held here anymore.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
Thank you, and please pardon me...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(RADder's going on hiatus...?
And COL's closing down...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Hm? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I hear people singing... But who?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Oh, people are also singing down that way...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (This is so cool. I couldn't tell earlier since I took a back alley, but it's like they're all competing for everyone's attention...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (And they all seem to love what they're doing.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(So free and unbound by anything...
But it's also really tense... I kinda like this atmosphere...)

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: Hey, you! Wait up!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, you're from...

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: Here, take this. I felt bad about having you leave empty-handed after going out of your way to visit, so I brought you a flyer for this event happening in the area.

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: RADder's a tough act to follow, but you might enjoy seeing some events put on by other musicians.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Oh... Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: This place is incredible. It's like everybody's singing and they all really love what they're doing...

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: Yeah, this is a great place to sing...

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: Isn't it an amazing place? This town and everyone in it lives and breathes music.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Live and breathe music...

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: Yup. And things have only gotten more exciting after RAD WEEKEND. Suddenly all these young musicians are aspiring to RADder's level.

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: Just take a look. The one over there with the big crowd just entered junior high school. In fact, she's probably around the same age as you.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (She's an amazing singer and she looks like she's having a lot of fun... She's that good even though she's the same age as me?)

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: Her name's An. She's actually Ken's... You know KEN from RADder? She's his daughter.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: KEN's...?!

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: She's been telling everyone that she's going to put on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: What? Surpass RAD WEEKEND...?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (She's nuts. There's no way she can...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Out of all the singers I saw today while walking around here, she might have the most presence...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Surpass RAD WEEKEND, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(But I sorta get why...
To be able to sing that well, I bet she's prepared to do anything to make that happen.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(Right...
Which means I need to be willing to do the same thing.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (If I somehow managed to put on an event like that... No, I'll never be able to if I don't fully commit myself to it.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (If I can't stand on the stage I saw that night when my mind was totally blown... unless I give it everything I have...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I just have to commit and go for it!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I don't care how much time I have to spend. I'm not letting her...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (No, not just her! I'm gonna surpass everybody in town!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Excuse me...

rows.Speaker: COL Staff Member
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Would you mind if I sang here?

rows.Speaker: Local
rows.Line: Hm? Hey, that kid's singing right next to COL.

rows.Speaker: Local
rows.Line: His pitch is all messed up, but I'll give him that he's loud.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: Interesting...

rows.Speaker: Local
rows.Line: An, keep singing a while longer!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
Huh? Uh, sure...!
What should I do next?
One year later

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(I'm going third today...
There's still some time, so I think I'll grab a drink of water...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: What the...?! Dude, you got water all over my clothes! I'm on stage next too!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: You're sorry? You need to be more careful.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (What a pain...)

rows.Speaker: Older Musicians
rows.Line: What's with the attitude? And quit standing in the way of everyone. Seriously, who do you think you are?

rows.Speaker: Older Musicians
rows.Line:
Wait, I know this guy.
He's the one that's been singing in all these places around town, saying he's gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND or whatever.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line:
Surpass RAD WEEKEND?
Pretty big talk from someone with zero rep.

rows.Speaker: Older Musicians
rows.Line: I know, right? You'd expect to have heard of someone who goes around making that kind of declaration.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Wait, that was when I...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
No, I will surpass it...!
I don't care how impossible it sounds. I'm gonna do it...!

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: Again, big talk from a total loser.

rows.Speaker: Older Musicians
rows.Line:
Alright, that's enough.
He's still just a junior high schooler.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: Junior high schooler or not, RAD WEEKEND is the stuff of legends.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: So quit playing around. I hate it when people talk about surpassing it like it's no big deal.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I'm not playing around! I'm serious!

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: Anyway, his performance today is gonna spell it out for us. That no one here wants to hear him sing.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Hey guys.
Whoa, what's going on here...?!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (Oh, he's been singing around here a lot lately... Did he step on someone's toes...?)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (He really shouldn't go around making enemies like that...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Tact is what he's missing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(I see...
Akito went through quite a lot back then.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Man, talk about a blast from the past.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
You were so prickly back then.
Well, you still are even today...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Shut it. Also, that last part wasn't necessary.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Alright, alright. Sorry.
Still, you really didn't get along with any of the older musicians.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: That's why my jaw sorta dropped when you started using that kind and polite persona of yours...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I was desperate back then, okay?
I didn't have time to think about building relationships.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's definitely true.
Fortunately, as time went on, you started getting better and better.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Speaking of which, that's about the time you started running and singing at the park, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Also...
Oh, I remember someone began spreading this weird rumor about you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What weird rumor?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Oh, something about you messing up during an event...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Again, it was just a rumor! I didn't actually believe it! But you did sorta disappear for a while after that, so I thought you quit or something...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Huh? Akito's voice just went all...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Hm? What's wrong, Akito?
You have this strange look on your face.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's just...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That rumor was true.
That event you were just talking about... It happened at Crawl Green.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What?! Seriously...?!
